title: SAP Specialist
description:
SAP S/4HANA FICO AMS Consultant

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 production support for SAP S/4HANA Finance (FICO) modules.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent solutions for recurring system issues.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial closing activities with finance teams.
  • Handle critical finance incidents and communicate updates to business and IT stakeholders.
  • Support and troubleshoot SAP FI modules including:
  • General Ledger (FI-GL)
  • Accounts Payable (FI-AP)
  • Accounts Receivable (FI-AR)
  • Asset Accounting (FI-AA)
  • Bank Accounting and Electronic Bank Statements
  • Provide support for Controlling (CO) processes during closing cycles including:
  • Material Ledger
  • Cost Center Accounting
  • Profit Center Accounting
  • Allocations and settlements
  • Analyze integration issues between finance and logistics processes such as FI-MM and FI-SD integrations.
  • Deliver minor system enhancements and configuration updates within the AMS support scope.
  • Prepare functional documentation, test cases, and support user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Participate in change management and release processes.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation aligned with audit and compliance standards.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 7–10 years of experience in SAP FICO consulting or application support.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance modules.
  • Proven experience in Application Management Support (AMS) or production support environments.
  • Solid knowledge of FI modules including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, and Bank Accounting.
  • Working knowledge of SAP CO processes, especially Material Ledger and month-end close activities.
  • Experience handling incident management, problem management, and service requests.
  • Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Understanding of Brazil localization, taxes, and statutory financial requirements is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.
  • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification is a plus.

title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst – Fintech Consulting Engagement (Remote | Brazil) 300 Software | Full-time Consulting Role
description:
About the Engagement

300 Software is expanding its presence in the US fintech market through a strategic consulting partnership with an online consumer lending company that provides lines of credit of up to $2,000 to everyday Americans for essential needs like medical, home repair, and unexpected expenses. They serve a broad, non-prime consumer segment, making real credit decisions in under 3 seconds in a data-heavy, high-volume environment where credit model performance directly impacts business outcomes.

This engagement is part of 300 Software's growing fintech practice, where we embed analytical and engineering talent within client operations — bringing Brazilian technical expertise to US financial services companies. The relationship has strong potential to evolve beyond analytics into tool development and deeper platform work.


The Role

As a Senior Credit Risk Analyst, you'll work as part of the 300 Software consulting team embedded with the client. This role sits at the intersection of data science, statistical modeling, and credit strategy — with direct visibility to executive leadership and real business impact from day one.

Your core mission is to identify issues inside credit models, analyze loan performance data, and help the team understand whether models are performing in line with expectations — and drive the changes when they're not.


What You'll Do

Monitor and analyze credit model performance, comparing actual loan behavior against model assumptions. Use regression analysis and other statistical and predictive tools to surface insights from performance data. Write complex SQL queries to extract and analyze data from cloud-based data lakes in an AWS environment. Build dashboards and reporting tools to communicate credit risk trends to leadership. Help define which borrower attributes to track and weight in underwriting decisions. Participate in weekly reporting meetings with the US-based team (Central Time Zone, 2 to 3 hour difference from Brazil). Collaborate with engineering and compliance teams to implement credit strategy improvements. Work alongside 300 Software's internal data and infrastructure team, which supports the client's AWS environment and data layer.


What We're Looking For

5 or more years of experience in credit analysis, data analytics, or a related quantitative role. Strong SQL skills including complex queries, data extraction, and reporting. Solid understanding of statistical modeling including regression analysis, predictive modeling, and scorecard development. Experience working with data lakes and cloud environments, with AWS being a plus. Comfort operating independently in a remote setup. Fluent English, as you will be in meetings and communicating directly with the US team. A background in engineering, statistics, or mathematics is a strong plus.


Setup

Remote from Brazil, full-time, 40 hours per week, with hours aligned to US Central Time Monday through Friday. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. Contract or PJ arrangements can be discussed.


Why This Role

This is not a typical outsourcing position. You'll be joining a consulting firm that is actively building its fintech practice in the US market, with a client relationship that is expected to grow. Strong performance here opens doors to broader product and tool development work as the engagement evolves.

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.


This role involves close work with low-level system internals, performance instrumentation, and automated test development.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance the PMC validation test suite on FreeBSD for modern platforms
  • Validate core, uncore, and IBS performance monitoring counters
  • Validate PMC multiplexing on FreeBSD
  • Validate proper PMC attach functionality to existing processes
  • Design and automate test scenarios across various performance monitoring frameworks
  • Collaborate with kernel engineers to analyze results, identify issues, and propose fixes or improvements
  • Maintain documentation, test plans, and validation reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks and test coverage


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)
  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware
  • Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)
  • Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks
  • Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year


Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


What we're looking for

  • 4-6 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate

description:

POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP SR (DBT e ETL)
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Migração de Dados OnPrem para Google Cloud Platform (GCP) no setor financeiro. Esse profissional será responsável pela construção, otimização e orquestração de pipelines de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e governança durante o processo de migração.


Descrição do Cargo:

O Engenheiro de Dados GCP Sênior será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Looker, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery) , garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

title: [Tech] Cientista de Dados (REMOTO)
description:
Descrição da vaga

A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes.

Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade.

O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos.
  • Realizar exploração, tratamento e modelagem de dados para gerar insights estratégicos.
  • Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas.
  • Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados.
  • Contribuir com a documentação técnica e boas práticas de ciência de dados.
  • Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e UX para garantir integração fluida das soluções ao produto final.
  • Participar de testes, validações e iterações de modelos em ambiente de produção.
  • Acompanhar tendências e inovações na área de dados e inteligência artificial, especialmente em aplicações de RH.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Graduação completa em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prática com modelagem estatística, machine learning e análise exploratória de dados.
  • Domínio de linguagens como Python (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, etc.) e SQL.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos e aplicações de LLMs (Large Language Models).
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Experiência prévia com dados de RH ou People Analytics.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização (ex: Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, Dash, etc.).
  • Experiência com deployment de modelos em ambiente de produção.

title: Delivery Manager
description:

Fazemos parte da AI/R Company , um ecossistema global de inovação que conecta tecnologia, dados e inteligência artificial para impulsionar negócios.

Você irá atuar como Delivery Manager em um cliente internacional, sendo facilitador entre times técnicos e stakeholders.   • Conduzir reuniões recorrentes com clientes (status, performance, riscos e alinhamentos)

  • Apoiar e manter a documentação interna relacionada ao cliente
  • Apoiar a liderança da Avenue Code na tomada de decisões estratégicas

  • Background técnico, preferencialmente em desenvolvimento de software

Desejáveis

  • Experiência com vendas ou suporte à área comercial

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)

About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

At Disruptive Talents, we connect commercially driven talent with high-growth financial services organizations. This search is conducted on behalf of an international Forex brokerage seeking to accelerate client acquisition, strategic partnerships, and revenue growth across the Brazilian and Latin American markets.


This is a strategic opportunity to join the commercial growth team at a critical stage of the company’s expansion in Brazil, playing a central role in developing client relationships, strategic partnerships, and long-term revenue growth in the local market.


About the Company


A regulated international Forex brokerage operating across multiple jurisdictions, the company provides trading access and infrastructure solutions to professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners. With a growing global footprint and a strong emphasis on technology, compliance, and scalable brokerage solutions, the firm continues to expand its presence in key regional markets, including Colombia, Mexico and Brazil.


As a Business Development Manager, you will focus on expanding the company’s footprint among professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of financial markets, brokerage products, and client trading needs, paired with a consultative, relationship-led sales approach.


What You Will Do:


Business Growth & Revenue

  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities across FX, CFDs, equities, derivatives, or multi-asset trading solutions.
  • Drive revenue growth through direct client acquisition and strategic partnerships (IBs, affiliates, money managers).
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, pitching, negotiation, onboarding coordination, and account growth.
  • Achieve and exceed individual and team revenue targets.


Client & Partner Management

  • Build long-term relationships with professional traders, institutional clients, and high-value partners.
  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor, aligning client trading needs with platform capabilities, pricing, and liquidity solutions.
  • Support retention and account expansion by identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities.


Market & Industry Intelligence

  • Stay current on global financial market trends, trading technologies, and competitor offerings.
  • Monitor regulatory developments (e.g., MiFID II, FCA, CySEC, ASIC) and ensure commercial activity aligns with compliance requirements.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and client meetings.


Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with trading, liquidity, risk, compliance, and operations teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and service delivery.
  • Partner with marketing to support lead-generation campaigns and regional growth initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasts, and performance reporting via CRM tools.


What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 3–7+ years of business development, sales, or relationship management experience within financial markets brokerage (FX, CFDs, equities, crypto, or derivatives).
  • Strong understanding of trading platforms, brokerage revenue models, and client acquisition channels.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Deep interest in financial markets and trading products.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Relationship-driven, consultative sales mindset.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and comfortable working with CRM and reporting tools.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission.
  • Exposure to global financial markets and high-value clients.
  • Clear career progression in a fast-growing brokerage environment.
  • Collaborative, performance-oriented culture.


How to Apply:

  • If you thrive in fast-moving financial markets and enjoy building profitable, long-term client relationships, we’d love to hear from you

title: Especialista CX - Afirmativa PCD
description:
Nossa área de Customer Experience (CX) é uma das principais alavancas de retenção e eficiência do grupo. Responsável por garantir que a jornada do cliente seja fluida, o time de CX atua na intersecção entre as áreas de Comercial, Implantação e Suporte, transformando indicadores em projetos estratégicos de otimização operacional.


Como Especialista de CX e Qualidade operacional, você trabalhará com equipes multifuncionais para identificar gargalos que impactam a experiência do cliente e a performance do negócio. Você será o guardião dos Fóruns de Qualidade, liderando os esforços desde o diagnóstico de indicadores até a implementação de novos fluxos de trabalho.


É uma função de ritmo acelerado e alta visibilidade, onde o foco é a resolução de problemas complexos. O Especialista lidera a conexão entre os silos da organização, a consolidação de processos de atendimento e a transferência de boas práticas entre os times para garantir que o cliente alcance o sucesso no menor tempo possível.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Liderar os Fóruns de CX e Operações: Garantir o ótimo relacionamento com os líderes de Comercial, Suporte e Implantação, alinhando metas, processos e comunicação.
  • Gestão de Indicadores: Analisar e reportar o progresso de métricas críticas (TTV, CSAT, Throughput, Tempo de Resposta) em relação aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Mapeamento de Jornada: Desenhar processos e modelos de atendimento, identificando proativamente oportunidades de otimização e redução de atrito para o cliente.
  • Gestão de Projetos de Melhoria: Desenvolver e acompanhar planos de ação pós-diagnóstico, garantindo que as melhorias discutidas sejam implementadas e gerem o valor esperado.
  • Mitigação de Riscos: Identificar gargalos operacionais que possam gerar churn ou queda de satisfação e ajustar os planos de execução conforme necessário.
  • Voz do Cliente: Assegurar a disseminação de feedbacks qualitativos para toda a organização, influenciando a evolução do produto e do serviço.
  • Report Estratégico: Comunicar o progresso das iniciativas de CX e os ganhos de eficiência para os stakeholders e lideranças.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Customer Experience, CX Ops ou Gestão de Projetos Operacionais.
  • Experiência em mapeamento de processos e desenho de jornadas de cliente.
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita clara, objetiva e com foco em dados.
  • Capacidade de engajar e liderar pessoas e áreas, independente de subordinação hierárquica (influência lateral).
  • Perfil analítico e executor: Conforto em navegar entre dashboards e a implementação prática de processos.
  • Desejável conhecimento em metodologias ágeis ou melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma ou Design Thinking).
  • Formação superior completa.

title: Analista de sistemas sênior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Estamos procurando um Analista de Sistemas com grande capacidade de comunicação e espírito investigativo para se juntar à nossa equipe de TI. Este profissional dará suporte e implementará aplicativos de laboratório, ferramentas de controle estatístico, integrações e serviços em nuvem. O candidato ideal deve ser hábil em conduzir sessões de descoberta com equipes de negócios, analisar problemas de ponta a ponta e traduzir as necessidades de negócios em soluções práticas e técnicas.

Responsabilidades:

• Liderar atividades de descoberta para compreender processos de negócios, necessidades dos usuários e requisitos do sistema.

• Realizar investigações aprofundadas e análises de causa raiz para questões técnicas e funcionais.

• Atuar como ponte de comunicação fundamental entre equipes de negócios, usuários finais e TI.

• Implementar, configurar e dar suporte a aplicativos de laboratório (LIMS, automação de software de integração, ferramentas de QC/QA, plataformas de revisão de dados).

• Dar suporte a ferramentas de controle estatístico e qualidade analítica (monitoramento de dados, painéis de qualidade).

• Configurar e manter serviços do Azure, incluindo App Services, Storage, SQL e API Management (APIM).

• Compreender arquiteturas de servidor e realizar configurações no nível do aplicativo.

• Documentar processos, requisitos e decisões técnicas de maneira clara e estruturada.

• Colaborar com equipes globais de TI e fornecedores externos em melhorias e integrações de sistemas.

• Participar de testes de aceitação do usuário, validação e sessões de treinamento.


O que você precisa ter

• Graduação em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada.

• Certificações em Azure ou experiência equivalente são um diferencial.

• Experiência prévia em ambientes de laboratório, qualidade ou manufatura é uma vantagem.


Habilidades Técnicas

• Experiência com aplicativos de laboratório e sistemas de CQ/CQ.

• Conhecimento de estatística ou controle estatístico de processos (CEP).

• Experiência com serviços do Azure (App Services, Storage, APIM, SQL).

• Sólida compreensão de APIs, integrações e fluxos de dados.

• Familiaridade com ambientes de servidor e conceitos básicos de redes.

• Conhecimento de SQL (consultas, solução de problemas, compreensão de esquemas).

Habilidades interpessoais

• Forte mentalidade investigativa e analítica.

• Capacidade de traduzir detalhes técnicos em linguagem acessível aos negócios.

• Fortes habilidades organizacionais e de multitarefa.

title: Content Operations Specialist
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.


Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.


What You Will Do


Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings


Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

title: Especialista em Chatbot & Conversão — Curadoria, Otimização e Escala (WhatsApp e IA)
description:

Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.


O Papel

O Especialista em Chatbot & Conversão será responsável por evoluir a jornada conversacional da empresa no WhatsApp, nosso principal canal de aquisição e conversão. Essa pessoa atuará na otimização contínua da experiência, reduzindo atritos, recuperando leads e aumentando a eficiência do funil por meio de automação, testes e uso de IA.



Responsabilidades

  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar a jornada conversacional de ponta a ponta no WhatsApp, identificando gargalos, fricções e oportunidades de melhoria nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Evoluir a arquitetura dos fluxos conversacionais com foco em experiência, engajamento, recuperação e conversão.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups, segmentações e estrutura de fluxo.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios, campanhas de reengajamento e estratégias de recuperação.
  • Trabalhar na personalização da jornada a partir de clusters de audiência, comportamento e contexto do cliente.
  • Apoiar a construção de dashboards e análises da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados, garantindo visibilidade dos principais indicadores de performance.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com Marketing, Vendas, BI, Operações e Produto/Tech para transformar insights em melhorias concretas na experiência e nos resultados.
  • Contribuir com o uso de IA e automação para escalar conversas com mais eficiência, relevância e capacidade de conversão.


KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em Growth, CRO, Lifecycle, CRM, Produto ou áreas correlatas, com foco em conversão e evolução de jornada.
  • Vivência prática com canais conversacionais, especialmente WhatsApp, automação de mensagens e/ou chatbots.
  • Capacidade de mapear funis, identificar gargalos e transformar análise em ação.
  • Repertório em testes A/B, experimentação e otimização contínua de jornada.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada para acompanhar métricas de funil, cohort, LTV, CAC e performance por etapa.
  • Boa visão de experiência do cliente e comportamento em jornadas digitais.
  • Capacidade técnica para utilizar ou estruturar soluções com IA, agentes e automações aplicadas à conversão.
  • Boa comunicação e influência para atuar com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, crédito, cobrança, serviços financeiros ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Vivência com desenho de experiências conversacionais e arquitetura de fluxos.
  • Experiência em produto, CX ou gestão de jornadas digitais.
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Supabase, Metabase, Power BI ou ferramentas similares.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização, qualificação e conversão em canais conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.
  • Experiência com plataformas conversacionais como Blip, ColmeIA ou similares.


Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Quality Engineer (QE) — Automação- Sênior
description:

* Domínio de técnicas de teste de caixa preta e caixa branca.

Desejável:

title: SAP Basis Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

  • Build and operate AKS-based workloads and supporting Azure PaaS services , ensuring high availability and operational resilience.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments, ensuring deployment safety and environment isolation.
  • Operate and evolve Terraform-driven infrastructure, maintaining modular design, clean state management, and consistent IaC practices across environments.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure, and cost-effective Azure architectures.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently during incidents and architectural reviews with VP-level technical stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Azure cloud engineering or DevOps roles, with end-to-end ownership of production environments.
  • Expertise operating Kubernetes/AKS workloads and Azure PaaS services in production contexts.
  • IaC background with Terraform , including environment separation and state management at scale.
  • Use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.

About Us

Clinergy Health is a boutique CRO focused on delivering high-quality, highly tailored clinical development solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.

  • Ensure no study tasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
  • Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor; Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
  • Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
  • Verify the accuracy of study results;
  • Identify and resolve site issues;


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences;
  • 2+ years experience as a CRA on pharma or CRO companies(Mandatory);

  • Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
  • Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations

Skills

title: Amazon Graphic Designer / Creative Strategist

We are hiring an Amazon Graphic Designer to own the strategic development and execution of premium marketplace creatives.


This is not a task-based production role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, identify what needs to improve visually without being told, build creative briefs from product and customer analysis, and bring ideas from concept through implementation .


The right person understands that great Amazon creative is not just about making listings look better. It is about increasing click-through rate, improving conversion rate, answering buyer decision questions visually, and creating a premium brand experience that feels custom, polished, and mobile-first.



What You’ll Own

  • CTR-optimized main images
  • Amazon infographics

  • Create designs that clearly answer buyer decision questions using strong hierarchy, thoughtful white space, and strategic visual storytelling
  • Use design flow intentionally in A+ Content and Brand Stores to guide the shopper’s eye and improve engagement
  • Identify visual weaknesses and missed opportunities in product listings without needing step-by-step direction

  • Bring ideas from ideation to execution, including concepting, layout, design, revision, and final production-ready files
  • Leverage AI tools to augment product photography, generate lifestyle imagery, and accelerate creative workflows while maintaining a premium, realistic output
  • Ensure all work is marketplace-compliant, polished, and built for conversion
  • Self-audit all work for alignment, consistency, accuracy, realism, proportion, mobile readability, and premium brand presentation
  • Partner with strategy and account teams to prioritize the highest-impact visual opportunities
  • Support A/B testing initiatives and use testing data to inform creative recommendations



What We’re Looking For


  • 5+ years of graphic design experience
  • Strong portfolio of ecommerce design work
  • Strong understanding of Amazon , including the role of main images, image sequencing, A+ flow, and Store navigation
  • Ability to work independently and proactively

Required Skills

  • You understand how to make creative feel premium, not generic

This is not a normal job. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to help build something meaningful from the ground up and work directly with the founder to drive execution, growth, and long-term value.


About the role

We are hiring a Founding General Manager / Operating Partner to help lead execution across the business. This person will help bring structure, accountability, and momentum to CoHostly while taking a major load off the founder.

This role is ideal for someone who is strong in operations, growth, sales support, team coordination, and making things happen in early-stage environments.


What you’ll be responsible for

  • Help run day-to-day execution across the business

  • Contribute to growth efforts including partnerships, outbound support, and business development initiatives


Who we’re looking for

  • Strong operator with experience in startups, SaaS, fintech, marketplaces, or high-growth businesses
  • Highly organized and execution-focused
  • Able to work directly with a founder and thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong communicator who can manage moving pieces and drive progress
  • Comfortable wearing multiple hats across ops, growth, sales support, and team coordination
  • Resourceful, proactive, and able to solve problems without constant direction
  • Serious about building, not just collecting a paycheck


Preferred background

  • Experience working in a startup or early-stage company
  • Experience in business operations, product operations, general management, chief of staff, or growth
  • Experience helping scale teams, systems, or revenue
  • Experience managing remote teams or contractors
  • Bonus if you have experience in SaaS, fintech, automotive, fleet, or marketplace businesses


What success looks like

In the first 90 days, you should be able to:

  • create more structure and accountability across the business
  • improve execution speed
  • organize priorities and workflows
  • help move key growth and product initiatives forward
  • increase revenue and sales
  • make the company easier to run and easier to scale


Compensation

Compensation will depend on experience and background. This role includes base compensation with performance-based upside. Long-term incentive or equity potential may be available for the right person after proven execution.


How to apply

Please send:

  • your resume
  • a short intro about your background
  • 2–3 examples of similar work you’ve done
  • a brief explanation of why you’re a strong fit for this role

We are looking for someone sharp, reliable, and high-level. Remote is fine. Overseas is fine. What matters most is that you can execute.
