title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Jr - Collect & Ingestion
description:
A JUIT é uma legaltech (startup do ramo jurídico). Nosso objetivo é otimizar a pesquisa jurídica para operadores do direito, estruturando dados do Judiciário brasileiro em uma plataforma de busca e jurimetria.

Iniciamos nossas atividades em 2018 e desde então já tivemos diversos reconhecimentos, seja em inovação ou na área de tecnologia.


Vaga

A equipe de Engenharia de Dados da JUIT concentra-se em estruturar e potencializar grandes volumes de dados jurídicos provenientes de múltiplas fontes públicas e privadas. Por meio de arquiteturas robustas, pipelines escaláveis e técnicas avançadas de processamento de dados, o time transforma informações brutas e heterogêneas em ativos confiáveis, estruturados e prontos para geração de valor.

Nossa engenharia atua em todo o ciclo de vida do dado: da coleta e ingestão, passando por tratamento, normalização e enriquecimento, com pipelines de IA, até a disponibilização para produtos, API's e modelos inteligentes. Trabalhamos continuamente para elevar a qualidade, a consistência e a rastreabilidade das informações, garantindo que cada dado entregue pela JUIT contribua diretamente para decisões mais seguras, eficientes e estratégicas no contexto jurídico.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Jr para fazer parte do nosso time de coleta e ingestão de dados (Collect & Ingestion). 


ATENÇÃO: Candidatos fora do perfil serão ignorados.


O que você fará:

  • Desenvolver soluções para coleta e ingestão de dados;
  • Atuar em conjunto com nosso time de engenharia para publicar serviços de dados para uso interno e externo de forma escalável e observável;
  • Coletar, mapear e analisar dados de diversas fontes, estruturadas ou não;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com nosso time de segurança para garantir políticas de segurança de dados e compliance;
  • Desenvolver frameworks de testes para melhorar e garantir a qualidade dos dados coletados;
  • Monitorar e documentar o status de scrapers em produção e soluções já implantadas;
  • Definir e implementar métricas para monitoramento de cargas de trabalho, alinhadas aos frameworks utilizados, incluindo indicadores de SLA, SLO e SLI, para garantir observabilidade e desempenho consistente.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em exatas (Ciências da computação, engenharia ou áreas relacionadas);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python (2+ anos de experiência);
  • Conhecimentos em linguagem SQL (+1 anos de experiência);
  • Experiência com coleta de dados da web (web scraping, web crawling, RESTful API’s, datasets públicos);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em algoritmos e estruturas de dados;
  • Conhecimentos em desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD);
  • Conhecimentos em Docker;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com processamento e extração de dados de documentos (.DOCs, .RTFs, .PDFs, etc);
  • Experiência com motores de busca de texto como Elasticsearch, Solr, OpenSearch, Sphinx, Amazon CloudSearch, Vespa e afins;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nas linguagens Golang e/ou Rust;
  • Experiência com pelo menos uma linguagem de programação baseada na JVM (Java, Scala, Clojure, etc.);
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Pulumi, Chef, Ansible, etc.);
  • Experiência com coleta de dados de mídia (áudio e vídeo) e sua transcrição para texto;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes.


Período: Integral

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Position Overview

Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
  • Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
  • Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
  • Coordinate with internal teams including eDiscovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
  • Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
  • Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
  • Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion


Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
  • Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
  • Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion


Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
  • Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
  • Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus


About Gemean

Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like PythAI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.

title: (Sr.) Enterprise Account Manager, DACH

(Remote innerhalb der EU – Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau/C2 & fließendes Englisch)


ÜBER LEVITY

Levity ist eine No-Code-KI-Automatisierungsplattform, die es Unternehmen ermöglicht, KI-gestützte Workflows zu entwickeln und einzusetzen, ohne Programmierkenntnisse zu benötigen. Levity unterstützt Teams dabei, wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben wie die Verarbeitung von E-Mails, Dokumenten, Bildern und Kundenanfragen zu automatisieren, indem KI-Modelle mit ihren eigenen Daten trainiert werden.

Levity wurde 2018 gegründet, hat 10 Mio. USD eingesammelt und wird von führenden Investoren unterstützt, darunter Balderton Capital sowie Angular Ventures. Mit Hauptsitzen in Deutschland und Chicago ist die Plattform darauf ausgelegt, KI auch für nicht-technische Teams zugänglich zu machen. Dadurch können Unternehmen ihre operative Effizienz in Bereichen wie Operations, Customer Support und Backoffice-Prozessen massiv steigern. Levity wird insbesondere von weltweit führenden Logistikunternehmen eingesetzt.

Einfach gesagt: Levity ermöglicht es Unternehmen, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe von KI zu automatisieren – ganz ohne Engineers.


ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Wir suchen einen (Sr.) Enterprise Account Manager , der die strategisch wichtigsten Kundenbeziehungen von Levity mit globalen Logistikführern verantwortet und ausbaut (z. B. Gebrüder Weiss, LKW Walter). Du übernimmst Accounts nach dem Sales-Abschluss mit dem Ziel, daraus Partnerschaften im Multi-Millionen-Dollar-Bereich zu entwickeln.

Dies ist keine rein administrative Bestandskundenrolle. Es ist eine kommerzielle Position mit hohem Impact, Fokus auf das Navigieren in komplexen multinationalen Organisationen und das Vorantreiben signifikanter Umsatzexpansion. Die Position berichtet direkt an die Gründer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Account Ownership: Du verantwortest ein fokussiertes Portfolio von 3 bis 5 hochwertigen Enterprise Accounts.
  • Revenue Expansion: Du treibst starkes Wachstum innerhalb bestehender Accounts voran, indem du neue Abteilungen, Regionen und Use Cases erschließt.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du analysierst komplexe Organisationsstrukturen und baust Beziehungen zu C-Level Executives sowie operativen Champions über verschiedene Tochtergesellschaften hinweg auf.
  • Commercial Strategy: Du führst Vertragsverhandlungen und Renewals und entwickelst Kunden hin zu langfristigen, großvolumigen Commitments.
  • Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Solutions Engineers und Produktteams zusammen, um eine erfolgreiche Delivery sicherzustellen.
  • Travel: Regelmäßige Reisen zu Kundenstandorten (z. B. Hamburg, Wien, Belgien oder USA), um persönliche Beziehungen vor Ort zu pflegen.


DEIN PROFIL

  • Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Enterprise Account Management oder Sales, insbesondere in der Betreuung multinationaler Accounts.
  • Startup DNA: Erfahrung in einem wachstumsstarken Umfeld ist essenziell. Du bist hands-on, denkst unternehmerisch und besitzt eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität.
  • AI & Tech Fluency: Du bist kein Engineer, kannst aber mit technischen Führungskräften auf Augenhöhe über den Nutzwert von KI-Workflows sprechen.
  • Language: Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (C2) sowie verhandlungssicheres Englisch sind zwingende Voraussetzungen.
  • Industry Background: Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Logistik, Supply Chain oder 3PL ist ein großes Plus. Wir sind jedoch offen für Top-Performer aus anderen komplexen Branchen (Telco, Manufacturing, etc.).


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Target Earnings: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit Fixum + Equity.
  • Incentives: Ungedeckeltes Provisionsmodell mit starkem Fokus auf Expansion Revenue.
  • Impact: Direkter Zugang zum Leadership-Team und die Chance, unser Enterprise-Sales-Playbook aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Flexibility: Remote-Work von überall in Europa oder hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Berliner Büro.
  • Team: Ein internationales, talentiertes Team aus über 20 Mitgliedern weltweit.


Additional notes:

  • Interview will be conducted in English, as the language is mandatory for this role
  • All applicants are carefully reviewed by our team daily and if we see a strong match to the role, you will be contacted via LinkedIn or e-mail. If you're not contacted, we believe it's not a match this time and will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

description:
Responsabilidades

O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 16 países, com mais de 2.000 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 22 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Tonus Gym, Aera, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


Em quais regiões há posições abertas?


  • SP - São Paulo – Residir na Capital
  • RJ - Rio de Janeiro - Residir na Capital
  • BA- Salvador - Residir na Capital
  • DF- Brasília – Residir Brasília ou Goiânia


O(a) Supervisor(a) de Manutenção será responsável por:

  • Realizar tarefas rotineiras sob supervisão direta.
  • Acompanhar a execução e garantir a qualidade da manutenção preventiva e corretiva junto aos prestadores, receber e validar os relatórios para pagamento via plataforma de gestão (Trilogo).
  • Inspecionar as estruturas prediais para determinar a necessidade de reparos ou restaurações, gerar relatório de visita bimestral.
  • Gerar relatório referente aos serviços de impacto nas unidades, com fotos de antes de depois da execução.
  • Receber, controlar, registrar e acompanhar as ordens de serviço, garantindo que todas as solicitações de manutenção sejam processadas de forma eficiente através da plataforma de gestão Trilogo.
  • Manter contato com fornecedores de peças e serviços de manutenção, solicitando cotações, acompanhando pedidos e recebimentos.
  • Gestão dos processos de manutenção, reparos e reformas das unidades a fim de garantir a padronização e a qualidade das instalações.
  • Gestão do cronograma e atividades dos manutencista (N1 e N2)
  • Recebimento de novas unidades, elaborando checklist de pendencias e acompanhar a regularização das pendencias.


Requisitos


Itens não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Experiência em manutenção predial.
  • Formação em engenharia.
  • Experiência com Gestão de Equipe.


Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Nos esforçamos para manter um ambiente descontraído, onde a opinião de todos reflete nas decisões da equipe. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa e criativa. Estamos em constante evolução e sempre abertos a novas tendências.

title: Head of GTM & Growth | Valere Evolve
description:
About Valere Evolve

Valere Evolve is an AI transformation platform that accelerates AI maturity by unifying workforce education, custom development, knowledge capture, and autonomous execution into a single integrated system. Built on three connected pillars — Learn, Build, and Scale — each phase feeds directly into the next. Learning prepares the workforce. Labs builds the systems. Dactic captures institutional knowledge. Conducto orchestrates execution at scale. The result is a continuous transformation loop rather than a stack of disconnected tools and vendors. One platform. From ambition to AI-native operations.


The Role

As Head of GTM & Growth, you are the commercial engine behind Valere Evolve. You will own the full go-to-market strategy and growth execution — from market positioning and pipeline creation to partnership development and revenue scaling. This is not a planning role. You will be expected to build, launch, and iterate in market with the same hands-on urgency that defines the product itself.

You bring demonstrated experience taking AI products and platforms to market, using AI-native tools to scale your own work, and a track record of growing user bases through high-leverage execution. You have done this before. You know what it takes to move a technical platform from early adopters to scaled commercial traction, and you know how to do it with a lean, intelligent team.

This role requires the ability to execute across multiple simultaneous growth motions — and the strategic judgment to know when to lean into each one based on what the market is telling you.


Impact You Will Have

  • Own Market Entry & Expansion: Define and execute the GTM strategy across target segments, verticals, and channels — translating Valere Evolve's platform vision into a repeatable, scalable motion that drives pipeline and accelerates time-to-revenue
  • Build the Growth Engine: Design and personally run the growth infrastructure — outbound sequences, nurture flows, content strategy, and conversion optimization — leveraging AI-native tools to operate at a velocity that outpaces traditional GTM teams
  • Drive Strategic Partnerships: Identify, develop, and close high-leverage partnerships with channel partners, systems integrators, enterprise resellers, and platform ecosystems that unlock distribution and accelerate adoption at scale — structuring agreements that embed platform value directly into partner programs as a retention and growth mechanism
  • Expand from Within: Develop and execute playbooks that convert active client relationships into platform adoption, creating organic expansion from within accounts that are already experiencing Valere's value firsthand
  • Translate Product Into Commercial Narrative: Work closely with product and delivery to develop positioning, messaging, and sales enablement that clearly articulates the value of the Learn → Build → Scale loop to enterprise buyers
  • Convert Strategy to Revenue: Build the frameworks, KPIs, and real-time dashboards that connect GTM activity to pipeline health, conversion rates, expansion revenue, and customer acquisition cost
  • Scale the User Base: Execute demand generation and account-based programs that grow the active user base across direct, partner-led, and paid acquisition channels — with measurable growth targets tied to platform adoption milestones


Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Strategy & Multi-Motion Execution — Own the full go-to-market roadmap including ICP definition, pricing frameworks, and launch execution. You will design and operate across multiple distinct growth motions simultaneously, building the systems to manage, measure, and optimize each one with clarity and speed
  • Partnership Development & Distribution — Source and structure strategic partnerships that create meaningful distribution leverage — including experience embedding platform capabilities and educational content directly into partner programs, proposals, and client engagements. Own the full partnership lifecycle from identification through activation and ongoing revenue contribution
  • Account Expansion & Organic Growth — Build and execute the internal playbooks, enablement materials, and account triggers that convert existing relationships into platform adoption and drive organic growth from within active engagements. Identify the signals that indicate expansion readiness and move on them
  • Targeted Outbound & Enterprise Penetration — Execute precision outbound campaigns targeting key individuals and internal champions inside large organizations. Build the entry-point strategy, manage the champion relationship, and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption to grow platform footprint organically from the inside out
  • Paid Acquisition & Influence-Driven Demand — Build and manage a paid acquisition strategy that drives platform awareness and qualified demand at scale — including the identification and activation of credible voices in the AI and enterprise transformation space to amplify reach and accelerate top-of-funnel growth
  • AI-Native Operations — Build and operate GTM workflows using AI-native tools — from prospecting automation and pipeline intelligence to content generation and deal acceleration. You use the tools. You don't delegate the tools.
  • Revenue & Pipeline Ownership — Work directly with sales and leadership to manage pipeline, forecast accuracy, and growth targets. You are accountable to the number.
  • Market Intelligence — Continuously monitor the competitive landscape, buyer behavior, and adoption trends to sharpen positioning and identify untapped growth vectors across all active acquisition channels
  • Cross-Functional Alignment — Serve as the connective layer between product, delivery, and commercial teams — ensuring GTM motion is tightly integrated with product roadmap, customer outcomes, and client-facing team capabilities


What We Look For

  • Experience: 4+ years in GTM, growth, or commercial leadership roles, with at least 2 years of demonstrated experience bringing AI products or platforms to market in a hands-on capacity
  • AI Product GTM (Required): Proven track record of taking AI-native products or platforms from early traction to scaled commercial adoption. You understand the buyer journey, the objections, the trust barriers, and what actually moves enterprise deals forward
  • AI-Native Operator (Required): You actively use and scale your work with AI tools. You have built GTM workflows, systems, and processes powered by AI automation — not as a pilot, but as standard operating procedure
  • Multi-Motion GTM Execution (Required): Demonstrated ability to design and run multiple simultaneous growth motions — partner-led distribution, account expansion, precision outbound, and paid acquisition — and the strategic maturity to resource and prioritize across them as market conditions evolve
  • Partnership Builder: Demonstrated ability to develop and close strategic partnerships that create real distribution leverage — including experience structuring agreements where platform access or educational content is embedded as a core component of the partnership value proposition
  • Account Expansion Experience: Proven ability to convert existing client or customer relationships into product adoption — building the internal plays and triggers that drive organic growth from within active accounts
  • Enterprise Outbound & Champion Development: Hands-on experience running targeted outbound to individual practitioners and decision-influencers inside large organizations, with the ability to build internal champions and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption
  • Paid Acquisition & Influencer Marketing: Working knowledge of paid acquisition strategy in B2B and B2B2C contexts, including performance measurement, creator or partner identification, and building programs that sustain organic reach alongside paid investment
  • Strategic Mindset with Execution Bias: You can build the roadmap and execute it in the same week. You are equally comfortable in a board-level positioning conversation and building the outbound sequence that follows it
  • Data-Driven Growth: Fluency in GTM analytics, funnel metrics, and revenue operations. You build dashboards, track what matters, and adjust based on signal — not assumption
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling narratives for enterprise buyers, partners, and executive stakeholders across every channel and motion
  • Builder Mentality: You don't wait for a team or a budget to grow. You find leverage, build fast, and scale what works
  • Genuine Enthusiasm for AI: Deep curiosity about the evolving AI landscape and a conviction that AI transformation is the defining enterprise challenge of this decade


How to Apply

To be considered for this role, all applicants must submit a brief Loom or video recording (5 minutes or less) shared with , including two things:

  • A personal introduction — who you are, what drives you, and why this role and this moment in AI transformation excites you
  • A concrete GTM example — walk us through a specific product or platform you've taken to market. We want the real story: the motion you chose, the obstacles you hit, how you adapted, and the measurable outcome. Slide decks and polished narratives are not what we're looking for. Show us how you think and execute.

Submissions without a video will not be reviewed. We are not evaluating production quality — we are evaluating clarity of thought, commercial instinct, and evidence of hands-on execution.

title: (Sr.) Enterprise Account Executive, DACH
description:
(Remote innerhalb der EU – Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau/C2 & fließendes Englisch)


ÜBER LEVITY:

Levity ist eine No-Code-KI-Automatisierungsplattform, die es Unternehmen ermöglicht, KI-gestützte Workflows zu entwickeln und einzusetzen, ohne Programmierkenntnisse zu benötigen. Levity unterstützt Teams dabei, wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben wie die Verarbeitung von E-Mails, Dokumenten, Bildern und Kundenanfragen zu automatisieren, indem KI-Modelle mit ihren eigenen Daten trainiert werden.

Levity wurde 2018 gegründet, hat 10 Mio. USD eingesammelt und wird von führenden Investoren unterstützt, darunter Balderton Capital, eine der renommiertesten Venture-Capital-Gesellschaften Europas, sowie Angular Ventures. 

Mit HQ in Deutschland und Chicago und einer globalen Präsenz ist die Plattform darauf ausgelegt, KI auch für nicht-technische Teams zugänglich zu machen, indem sie die Erstellung und Implementierung von Automatisierungen über eine einfache visuelle Benutzeroberfläche ermöglicht. Dadurch können Unternehmen ihre Workflows optimieren, manuelle Arbeit reduzieren und die operative Effizienz in Bereichen wie Operations, Customer Support und Backoffice-Prozessen steigern. Levity wird insbesondere von weltweit führenden Logistikunternehmen eingesetzt.

Einfach gesagt: Levity ermöglicht es Unternehmen, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe von KI zu automatisieren – ganz ohne Engineers.


ÜBER DIE ROLLE DES ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE:

Wir suchen einen (Sr.) Enterprise Account Executive , der ein neues Geschäft vorantreibt und strategische Partnerschaften mit globalen Marktführern in der Logistik aufbaut. Du bist verantwortlich für die Identifikation, Ansprache und den Abschluss von hochkarätigen Enterprise-Kunden, mit dem Ziel, langfristige Partnerschaften im Multi-Millionen-Dollar-Bereich aufzubauen.

Dies ist eine kommerzielle Rolle mit großem Einfluss, mit Fokus auf das Navigieren in komplexen multinationalen Organisationen, das Identifizieren wertvoller Use Cases und das Generieren signifikanter neuer Umsätze. Die Position berichtet direkt an die Gründer.


Wesentliche Verantwortlichkeiten

• Enterprise Sales Ownership: Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle für strategische Enterprise-Prospects, von der ersten Ansprache und Discovery bis hin zu Verhandlung und Abschluss.

• New Revenue Generation: Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Enterprise-Kunden, mit Fokus auf wirkungsstarke Use Cases und groß angelegte Deployments.

• Stakeholder Management: Du bewegst dich sicher in komplexen Organisationsstrukturen und baust Beziehungen zu C-Level Executives, Entscheidungsträgern und operativen Führungskräften über verschiedene Tochtergesellschaften und Länder hinweg auf.

• Commercial Strategy: Du führst kommerzielle Gespräche, entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Angebote und verhandelst Verträge, um langfristige Enterprise-Partnerschaften zu sichern.

• Collaboration: Du arbeitest während des Sales-Prozesses eng mit Solutions Engineers und Produktteams zusammen, um Lösungen zu gestalten, die den Kundenanforderungen entsprechen und gleichzeitig erfolgreiche Abschlüsse ermöglichen.


Wen wir suchen und wer in dieser Rolle erfolgreich sein wird:

• Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung als Enterprise Account Executive oder im Vertrieb, mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz beim Abschluss komplexer Deals innerhalb multinationaler Organisationen.

 • Startup DNA: Erfahrung in einem wachstumsstarken Startup-Umfeld ist essenziell. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, ohne die Ressourcen eines Großkonzerns zu arbeiten. Du bist hands-on und bringst eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität mit.

• Technically competent to navigate AI discussions: Auch wenn du kein Engineer bist, wirst du mit technischen Führungskräften, Operations-Leads und deren Teams sprechen und ihnen vermitteln, welchen enormen Mehrwert Levity für ihre Organisation schaffen kann. Deshalb brauchst du ein solides Verständnis von KI sowie ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis.

• Language: Deutsch auf Muttersprachiveau/C2 und fließendes Englisch. 

• Industry Background: Ein großes Plus ist Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Logistik, Supply Chain oder 3PL. Gleichzeitig sind wir offen für Top-Performer aus anderen komplexen Branchen, z. B. Telco, Manufacturing etc.

• Gemeinsam mit den Gründern wirst du zudem das Gesicht von Levity auf Konferenzen und Events sein. Du solltest gerne reisen, um an Konferenzen teilzunehmen und Kunden weltweit zu besuchen. Die meisten Konferenzen finden in Europa und den USA statt, während sich die Kunden global verteilen. Es wird keine monatlich feste Reisetätigkeit geben, aber einige Monate werden reiseintensiver sein als andere.


Vergütung & Benefits:

• Target Earnings: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit Fixum + Bonus + Equity.

• Incentives: Ungedeckeltes Provisionsmodell mit starkem Fokus auf Expansion Revenue.

• Impact: Direkter Zugang zum Leadership-Team und die Möglichkeit, unseren Enterprise-Sales-Playbook aktiv mitzugestalten.

• International team: Levity zählt über 20 talentierte Mitarbeitende und wächst weiter. Das Team ist in Europa (Deutschland, Spanien, Portugal, Polen, Schweden), Brasilien, APAC und weiteren Regionen vertreten.

• Remote: Du kannst von überall in Europa aus arbeiten. Levity hat außerdem ein Büro in Berlin, falls du eine hybride oder Office-basierte Rolle bevorzugst.

• Travel: Du solltest dich mit umfangreicher Reisetätigkeit wohlfühlen, um Kunden weltweit zu treffen und bei Bedarf an Konferenzen teilzunehmen.


Additional notes:

  • Interview will be conducted in English, as the language is mandatory for this role
  • All applicants are carefully reviewed by our team daily and if we see a strong match to the role, you will be contacted via LinkedIn or e-mail.
  •  If you're not contacted, we believe it's not a match this time and will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

title: Gerente de Marketing
description:
VAGA: Gerente de Marketing

Cooperlink Brasil – Presencial


Sobre a Cooperlink

Na Cooperlink, marketing não é estética; é crescimento, margem e decisão.

Trabalhamos com metas claras, KPIs definidos e uma visão estratégica orientada a resultado. Nosso foco é escalar com eficiência, mantendo controle financeiro e um posicionamento de marca consistente.

Buscamos alguém que una criatividade estratégica e capacidade de execução, com maturidade para liderar pessoas e transformar ideias em execução e execução em resultados mensuráveis.


Missão do Cargo

Liderar a operação de marketing, com foco claro em resultado, garantindo que a estratégia se traduza em execução eficiente, geração de demanda, vendas e crescimento comercial, orientados por KPIs e performance.


Principais Responsabilidades:
  • Responsável pela expansão e consolidação da marca Cooperlink no Brasil;
  • Organizar rotinas, processos e fluxo de demandas para ganho de eficiência operacional, garantindo que projetos envolvendo diferentes talentos sejam bem estruturados, com prazos e objetivos claros, e que haja excelência na execução das áreas de Design, Copywriting, CRM, Tráfego Pago e Social Media.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de ação para aumentar a geração de leads e vendas, gerenciando campanhas em canais digitais e offline (Google, Meta, TikTok, Afiliados, Display, outdoors e influenciadores), com foco em performance e branding;
  • Garantir execução dentro de prazo, padrão e prioridade, conectando diferentes times para manter coerência nas entregas e maximizar o impacto em vendas, acompanhando resultados e ajustando estratégias com base em dados e performance.
  • Utilizar KPIs como ROI, CAC, LTV, margem e receita para orientar decisões estratégicas e priorização de ações.
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar o time de mídia, promovendo excelência técnica, visão crítica e mentalidade de teste, enquanto implementa rotinas de testes A/B, otimizações automatizadas e práticas inovadoras para maximizar a performance.
  • Padronizar entregáveis, relatórios e fluxos de gestão;
  • Manter uma cultura contínua de benchmarking e leitura de mercado, acompanhando tendências, referências e estratégias que estejam funcionando, para identificar e aplicar oportunidades relevantes de geração de demanda.


O que esperamos de você:
  • Experiência sólida em marketing, com foco em performance, growth e operação multicanal, incluindo vivência prática em Mídia de Performance e gestão de investimento em canais digitais.
  • Experiência com plataformas como Google Ads, Meta Ads e TikTok Ads
  • Capacidade comprovada de gestão de projetos e liderança de times, garantindo entregas dentro de prazo, padrão de qualidade e a coordenação de squads multidisciplinares.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultado
  • Forte capacidade de priorização, tomada de decisão e gestão simultânea de múltiplas frentes
  • Capacidade de analisar dados, otimizar campanhas e melhorar performance, com decisões orientadas a KPIs
  • Criatividade estratégica, com capacidade de propor ideias e campanhas além do operacional
  • Cultura de testes A/B contínuos, com análise de resultados e otimização orientada por dados
  • Inglês básico para navegação em ferramentas e materiais técnicos
  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Administração, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas;


Diferenciais que valorizamos:

title: Principal Solutions Architect
description:
About the Company

Space Dinosaurs builds fast, high-converting ecommerce experiences for the world's top brands, with a focus on conversion rate and revenue optimization. We're a specialist e-commerce and creative strategy firm that uses AI-augmented engineering and our CDN engineering heritage to deliver high-performance, scalable digital retail experiences that deliver exceptional revenue performance and growth. Together, we're a global team of talented designers, engineers, strategists, and operators who like solving hard problems, shipping work we're proud of, and tying our output to measurable results. Built on decades of retail technology expertise, we're redefining how retail grows. We are recognized by many of the world's leading retail and consumer brands for designing and building the fastest, most resilient, future-ready websites and applications that consistently deliver measurable outcomes in revenue.



About the Role

We design and ship headless commerce frontends for major retail brands — high-traffic storefronts where a 100ms regression in Largest Contentful Paint directly impacts conversion rates and revenue. You'll own the technical direction for one of our distributed delivery teams: designing front-end architectures, breaking epics into implementable stories, establishing the coding standards that keep a multi-team codebase coherent, and resolving ambiguity before it reaches a sprint. You'll work directly with clients during discovery and sprint planning, partner with leads and senior engineers through design reviews and ADRs, and collaborate async-first across time zones. The path leads to Principal Architecture with client-facing strategic influence across our commerce practice.


Responsibilities

  • Design and own front-end architectures using Next.js, React, and TypeScript for enterprise commerce implementations
  • Break epics into implementable stories with clear acceptance criteria, identifying technical dependencies and estimating complexity
  • Lead architectural decisions on rendering strategies, state management, caching, and performance optimization — and document them in ADRs
  • Drive Core Web Vitals performance across your delivery team, establishing standards engineers build against in every PR
  • Define coding standards and project conventions in formats that enable both engineers and AI agents to execute reliably
  • Collaborate with clients during discovery to translate business needs into scalable, pragmatic architecture roadmaps
  • Resolve technical ambiguity before sprint — unblocking engineers and escalating architectural drift when design intent diverges from implementation

Qualifications

  • Proven architectural experience designing front-end systems and leading distributed engineering teams (3+ people)
  • Deep proficiency in Next.js (App Router, React Server Components), React, TypeScript, and modern web architecture — SSR strategies, edge computing, serverless patterns

title: Senior Electromechanical Engineer - HV Substations
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Electromechanical Engineer with a strong background in high-voltage substation projects.


Our client is a leader in the design, implementation, and management of high-voltage systems. With a strong focus on innovation, they skilfully navigate the complexities of the energy sector, including grid enhancement and sustainable energy strategies. Their expertise plays a crucial role in driving a more environmentally conscious and energy-efficient future.


As the Senior Engineer within your project team, you focus lies in high-voltage components (primary systems) and the associated structures required for installing and mounting these components. Your responsibilities include:

  • Translating functional designs and requirements into concrete designs and project plans.

What You Bring to Succeed:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Electrical Power Engineering, or a similar field.
  • At least 5 years of experience designing complex high- and medium-voltage systems, with requirements related to availability, reliability, maintenance, and safety.
  • Key competencies: a proactive and entrepreneurial mindset you strive for the best results for both the project and yourself. Strong communication skills are essential, along with analytical thinking and a results-driven approach.
  • Willingness to relocate for a new job opportunity. The job location is in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

title: QA Engineer (Manual e Automação)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

— Estruturar e implementar o processo de qualidade dentro do projeto AAM, garantindo a estabilidade e qualidade das entregas em um sistema legado e crítico.

— Realizar testes manuais funcionais, regressivos e exploratórios em ambientes complexos que envolvem .NET, React e SQL Server.

— Criar, atualizar e manter planos de teste, casos de teste e evidências utilizando Confluence e Jira.

— Trabalhar em parceria com o Tech Lead e os Fullstack Developers, identificando falhas, prevenindo defeitos e assegurando a rastreabilidade completa entre requisitos, histórias, casos de teste e evidências.

— Apoiar na definição de processos, métricas e indicadores de qualidade (defect density, coverage, etc.), garantindo o acompanhamento de performance.

— Participar do planejamento das sprints, sinalizando riscos e propondo melhorias contínuas.

— Desenvolver, em médio prazo, o framework de automação de testes, definindo stack, estratégia e priorização de casos.


O que você precisa ter

— Experiência sólida em testes manuais (funcionais, regressão e integração).

— Conhecimento em ciclos de vida de software (SDLC) e metodologias ágeis.

— Capacidade de analisar requisitos técnicos e funcionais em sistemas complexos.

— Vivência com Jira, Confluence e controle de bugs.

— Habilidade para documentar claramente casos de teste e resultados.

— Excelente comunicação e inglês fluente para conversação.

— Perfil colaborativo e postura proativa junto ao time técnico e cliente.

Desejável

— Conhecimento em automação de testes com Selenium, Cypress ou Playwright.

— Experiência em testes de APIs (Postman, Newman, etc.).

— Conhecimento básico em .NET ou React, suficiente para compreender impacto de mudanças.

— Experiência em sistemas legados ou ambientes financeiros.

Perfil esperado

— Atenção aos detalhes e forte senso de qualidade.

— Mentalidade estruturada, organizada e orientada a processo.

— Curiosidade técnica e desejo de construir a automação do zero.

— Proatividade para antecipar falhas e propor melhorias.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Analista de validação de Sistemas Computadorizados - Sênior
description:
1- Elaborar, revisar e executar protocolos de validação de sistemas computadorizados (IQ/OQ/PQ) para garantir que os sistemas utilizados em processos de produção, controle de qualidade, laboratórios e áreas administrativas estejam em conformidade com as regulamentações da indústria farmacêutica.

2- Conduzir a análise de risco e impacto dos sistemas, com base nas diretrizes de GAMP 5.

3- Validar e monitorar o desempenho de sistemas relacionados ao gerenciamento de dados críticos, como sistemas SCADA, LIMS, ERP, sistemas de automação, entre outros.

4- Acompanhar o ciclo de vida completo dos sistemas, desde a especificação de requisitos de usuário (URS), passando pela validação inicial, até a manutenção contínua, garantindo conformidade e controle de mudanças adequados.

5- Suportar as etapas de design, implementação, teste, qualificação e validação de sistemas computadorizados e assegurar que todas as etapas sejam documentadas e aprovadas conforme os padrões internos e regulatórios.

6- Participar de investigações e análises de impacto relacionadas a mudanças nos sistemas computadorizados, identificando riscos à integridade de dados e propondo ações corretivas.

7- Participar de investigações de desvios relacionados aos sistemas, garantindo que as ações corretivas e preventivas (CAPAs) sejam executadas e documentadas adequadamente.

8- Fornecer suporte técnico durante auditorias internas e externas, bem como inspeções de órgãos regulatórios (ANVISA, FDA, EMA), respondendo a questionamentos sobre a validação dos sistemas computadorizados.

9- Garantir que os sistemas estejam preparados para auditorias, com a documentação de validação e rastreabilidade de dados completa e acessível.

10- Colaborar com as áreas de TI, automação, qualidade e produção para assegurar que os sistemas atendam às necessidades dos processos farmacêuticos e de controle de qualidade.

11- Fornecer orientação técnica e treinamentos sobre os procedimentos de validação e conformidade regulatória para outras equipes.

12- Implementar e validar sistemas que garantam a integridade de dados (Data Integrity), assegurando conformidade com os princípios ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, Completeness, Consistent, Enduring, Available).

13- Monitorar o uso dos sistemas, identificando e corrigindo qualquer falha ou vulnerabilidade que possa comprometer a integridade de dados críticos.

title: Analista de R&S
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.


Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de ANALISTA DE R&S abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso:


Principais atividades:


Conduzir processos de R&S de ponta a ponta, em parceria com líderes, realizando entrevistas e avaliações, garantindo boa experiência aos envolvidos. Atuar na melhoria contínua, gestão de indicadores, fortalecimento da marca empregadora, iniciativas de diversidade e organização dos processos para diferentes níveis de vagas.

title: Site Administrator
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce


Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).


Key Responsibilities

  • Support daily site operations.
  • Maintain and update technical documentation.
  • Manage POs, goods receipts, local suppliers, material inventory, and logistics records.
  • Support on-site procurement, control of tools, spare parts, and consumables.
  • Handle site administrative routines, including but not limited to invoice monitoring, fuel control, subcontractors / employees’ timesheet and other facilities control.
  • Support spares and consumables coordination to ensure material availability.

Job Requirements

  • Safety mindset.
  • Proactive, organized, and able to work independently.
  • Good communication.
  • SAP knowledge.
  • Advanced MS Excel.
  • Experience in energy or construction sectors.
  • Work allocated on-site
  • English desired

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
HR Business Partner (Operational HR Business Partner)

Based in Manaus - On site role

Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Industry: Automotive Manufacturing


As our HRBP, you will own the end-to-end HR experience for our site. Your goal is simple but vital: create a \"positive ecosystem\" where zero production loss occurs due to ER issues, and every employee feels aligned with the Royal Enfield values.


Responsibilities

  • Ensure all HR records and documents of the employees are maintained and updated
  • Roll out relevant induction programs for new joiners
  • Ensure completion of performance management activities of the PMS on time in collaboration with executive rewards and performance management
  • Identify training needs for employees and enable the learning and development initiatives, and create suitable L & D plan
  • Drive strategic local talent attraction initiatives to strengthen Royal Enfield’s employer Brand in the talent market, and build a sustainable talent pipeline, utilising social media such as linked in, local jobs boards, and building relationships, working with agencies.
  • Assist with resolving employee relations issues and address grievances
  • Develop initiatives to promote employee well-being and to increase employee engagement
  • Work closely with management and employees to improve work relationships, build morale and increase productivity and retention. Promote diversity, equality and inclusion initiatives and foster an inclusive workplace culture aligned with RE values
  • Ensure adherence to all applicable statutory and labour laws of the unit and compliance with all relevant statutes
  • Drive uninterrupted Business delivery by creating a positive ecosystem and ensuring no production loss due to Employee Relations issues
  • Monitor and ensure zero deviation in attendance & payroll process, successful implementation of Digitization and HR projects
  • Maintain harmonious industrial relations and ensure zero productivity loss due to IR issues


Who you are? Experience/ Qualifications:

  • Experienced: You have 5+ years in an operational HR role, ideally within Automotive or Manufacturing sectors.
  • Qualified: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources.
  • Communicator: You are fluent in English and possess strong conflict-resolution skills.
  • Tech-Savvy: You have excellent IT and reporting skills; you love a good metric!
  • Local Expert: You have a deep understanding of statutory regulations and Brazilian labor laws.


Royal Enfield - About Us:

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfields are engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach the brand calls Pure Motorcycling.

Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.

Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’25, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 18,870 crore s which is approximately USD 2.23 billion.

title: Operador(a) de Área - Recuperação e Evaporação
description:
A Arauco é um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais e se compromete com a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas práticas de contratação.


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Sobre a Função


Liderar e executar atividades operacionais complexas na área de campo das unidades de Evaporação e Recuperação, garantindo o funcionamento otimizado, seguro e contínuo dos equipamentos e processos, atuando como referência técnica e mentor para a equipe operacional de campo, liderando a resposta a anomalias, participando ativamente da análise de desvios e propondo melhorias nos procedimentos e equipamentos, contribuindo para o alcance das metas de produção, segurança, eficiência energética e recuperação de químicos.


Principais Atividades:

  • Operar e monitorar equipamentos das áreas de Evaporação e Recuperação, garantindo eficiência, segurança e continuidade operacional;
  • Realizar inspeções de campo, identificando anomalias e atuando preventivamente em falhas;
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas operacionais, atuando na causa raiz e na melhoria do processo;
  • Executar ajustes operacionais visando otimização de consumo de energia, recuperação de químicos e controle ambiental;
  • Apoiar/operar sistemas automatizados (SDCD) e substituir operador de painel quando necessário;
  • Liderar e orientar operadores de campo, distribuindo atividades e garantindo cumprimento de procedimentos;
  • Preparar equipamentos para manutenção, assegurando bloqueios e condições seguras de trabalho;

  • Registrar dados operacionais e contribuir com análises de desempenho e melhorias;
  • Atuar em situações de emergência, seguindo planos de contingência e garantindo a segurança;
  • Garantir cumprimento das normas de segurança, qualidade, meio ambiente e compliance;
  • Participar de iniciativas de melhoria contínua e otimização dos processos;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento da equipe, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Desejável Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharias e afins;

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

description:
BASE SALARY - USD 36,000-48,000K/YEAR

BONUS - UP TO USD 24,000/YEAR


Founded on the belief that the majority of the world’s population is deprived of the opportunity to reach their full potential. They are betting their lives on this by creating a system that identifies high-potential talent in low-opportunity environments and prepares them for lucrative technical careers.


Based in Brazil, their intensive apprenticeship program immerses participants in real-world commercial work through our analytics consultancy serving US businesses. This approach not only eliminates the financial barrier of education, often prohibitive for underprivileged populations, but also offers learners a comfortable wage from day one, enabling them to fully concentrate on mastering a new profession. They have found this model to be the most effective way of creating new analytics talent with proven ability to solve real-life business challenges.


What You’ll Do

Core Goal: Deliver excellent customer solutions via reliable, high-quality data analyses, strong communication, and top-tier problem solving

You will be a hire at our early-stage, profitable startup. We are still figuring out many aspects of this business, and we’re looking for a hands-on thought partner to help build the company while managing a client relationship day-to-day. We want to be upfront: this is not a 9-5 job, and it’s

really difficult at times, but our shared mission to serve is what we rally around.


Client Relationships

You’ll be the primary point of contact for one client to start, which is a US-based company. This client treats us as an integrated part of their data team, and this project will require strong business acumen, SQL, and BI skills (ex. Looker/Tableau). Our typical workflow consists of scoping work, completing the work, performing QA, and presenting to the client. As you prove our ability to solve customer problems, you’ll look for opportunities to expand our footprint within each business.


Analyst Training + Management

At the beginning, you will be working on your own. However, our goal is for this role to grow into a people management role. Once you reach that stage, you’ll manage and coach a team of analysts who are true beginners. They typically won’t have college degrees and they’ll have no prior analytics experience whatsoever. Our analysts have previously worked as receptionists, delivery drivers, waiters, and in other non-technical roles. You’re not just going to be teaching them SQL/analysis/critical thinking, but also how to navigate a different culture in their second language (English) and gain confidence in their new skills. Most importantly, you’ll be transforming their lives by changing their mindsets about what’s possible through coaching them to independently solve hard problems. If done right, we believe you will be empowering a new learner to sustainably 10x their income in 2 years or less.
